main.description: Builds an ordered GainForest activity feed from current indexed records for the registered feed and parameters selected in the request. The response contains references and selection metadata only: AT-URIs, CIDs, account DIDs, timestamps, and group counts. It does not contain record content. The caller hydrates the referenced records itself. A burst or audio item covers at most 200 rows; a longer run continues in the following items, which have continued set and the same groupKey and which clients merge into one card. Authentication is optional. When supplied, the AT Protocol service-auth issuer is the viewer. Anonymous requests that set params.following must provide params.viewerDid. Omitting params selects the global feed.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request or the selected feed's parameters are malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeed
errors.description: The requested feed identifier is not registered by this service.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible with the selected feed.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

feedId.description: Identifier of the feed algorithm to execute.

params.description: Algorithm-specific parameters. Optional for app.gainforest.feed.defs#activityFeed: when omitted, its defaults apply (filter all, following false).

limit.description: Maximum number of feed items to return. A burst or an audio run is one item per 200 rows. The selected feed determines the default and may enforce a lower maximum.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous request for this feed.

schema.description: Returns ordered feed items and an optional cursor for the next page. Items are references and selection metadata, not records.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.
